raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`ZImageTransformer2DModel._replace_padding_with_token` runs on every forward, for the image tokens and, without a caption mask, for the caption tokens. It writes the pad token through a boolean mask, `tensor[pad_mask] = pad`, which runs `nonzero` and blocks the host until the GPU catches up. It also builds the lengths with `torch.tensor(list, device=...)`, which is another blocking copy. Each forward therefore starts by draining the GPU queue, and the host loses the lead it needs to hide launch overhead.

## Modifications

- When the lengths are a Python list, write each padded row by slice (`tensor[row, length:] = pad`); there is no mask and no host-to-device copy.
- When the lengths are a tensor, select with `torch.where`, as the masked variant `_replace_padding_with_token_mask` in the same file already does.

Values are unchanged, since the change is a selection or copy with no arithmetic.

## Accuracy Tests

`python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_zimage_padding_no_sync.py` compares the result with the previous mask-assignment implementation, for list and tensor lengths. It runs under `torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")`, so any synchronizing CUDA call fails the test. On main, these tests fail with `called a synchronizing CUDA operation` at `zimage.py:1469`. The existing `test_zimage_pipeline_config` and `test_zimage_qknorm_fusion` pass. Z-Image-Turbo output md5 matches main at 512² and 1024².

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Z-Image-Turbo, 9 steps, one GPU, GB300. Servers for main and this PR were resident on the same GPU, requests alternated between them for 16 pairs, and processes were pinned to the GPU's NUMA node.

| | main | this PR | | this PR faster in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 512² | 362.7 ms | 360.4 ms | −0.6% | 13/16 |
| 1024² | 406.6 ms | 397.7 ms | −2.2% | 16/16 |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.zimage import ZImageTransformer2DModel
+
+_replace = ZImageTransformer2DModel._replace_padding_with_token
+
+
+def _mask_assign_reference(tensor, valid_lens, pad_token):
+    """The previous implementation: a boolean-mask write."""
+    positions = torch.arange(tensor.shape[1], device=tensor.device).unsqueeze(0)
+    lengths = torch.as_tensor(valid_lens, device=tensor.device).reshape(-1, 1)
+    out = tensor.clone()
+    out[positions >= lengths] = pad_token.to(tensor.dtype)
+    return out
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "requires CUDA")
+class TestZImagePaddingWithoutSync(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        torch.manual_seed(0)
+        self.tensor = torch.randn(3, 40, 64, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        self.pad = torch.randn(64, device="cuda")
+
+    def _check(self, valid_lens, as_tensor):
+        lens = torch.tensor(valid_lens, device="cuda") if as_tensor else valid_lens
+        expected = _mask_assign_reference(self.tensor, valid_lens, self.pad)
+        torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("error")
+        try:
+            out = _replace(self.tensor, lens, self.pad)
+        finally:
+            torch.cuda.set_sync_debug_mode("default")
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(out, expected))
+
+    def test_list_lengths(self):
+        self._check([40, 17, 0], as_tensor=False)
+
+    def test_tensor_lengths(self):
+        self._check([40, 17, 0], as_tensor=True)
+
+    def test_no_padding_returns_input(self):
+        self.assertIs(_replace(self.tensor, [40, 40, 40], self.pad), self.tensor)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
